runs.prompt:
Use case: style-transfer.
Asset type: orthographic ALBEDO texture source for an existing 3D model.
Edit input image 1 directly on its original 1024 x 1024 canvas. Keep its alpha mask and every existing model edge precisely registered. Change only surface colours.
Input 1 is the grey guide: absolute authority for silhouette, camera, size, position, edges, openings and all small details.
Input 2 is design_reference.png: authority for the ivory bone, thin gold-brown veins and blue-white beacon materials ONLY. Do not use its three-quarter shape or perspective.
Input 3 is concept_crop.png: supporting original design reference ONLY; do not copy its scenery or lighting.
Paint matte warm ivory bone plates with fine subtle bone grain and thin branching gold-brown veins, matching the approved design. Follow the model's existing ribs and plate shapes. The existing round beacon lens is blue-white with pale blue/periwinkle internal luminous colour wherever the guide actually exposes it. Keep the lens's exact foreshortening and occlusion in this side view; do not add a new front-facing lens. Existing foot rocks retain their exact shapes and positions and receive muted grey-brown stone colour.
LIGHTING: flat, even, shadowless from the viewer, unlit diffuse ALBEDO. All ivory surfaces including recesses have the same light ivory value regardless of orientation. Veins are matte gold-brown colour without relief shadows or shiny highlights. Do not copy the grey guide's shading. No cast shadows, ambient occlusion, dark cavities, strong specular highlights, reflections or rim light. Luminous parts are painted at their glowing colour with no bloom or light cast on the surrounding material.
Keep the guide's silhouette EXACTLY, including every small spike and the thin base. Do not add ornaments, stones or details outside it. Preserve the original alpha boundary pixel for pixel; replace only colours inside it. No resizing, reposing, rotating, cropping or changing the camera. No background, floor, shadow, text, labels, border or painted checkerboard.
Deliver ONE native 1024 x 1024 RGBA PNG with actual transparent background, the exact same canvas and pixel registration as input 1.
LEFT VIEW: guide_left.png. The arch is viewed edge-on as a tall narrow upright tapered blade, with the tip near (507,66), a central vertical ridge that splits into a pointed inverted-Y lower buttress, and a broad flaring base ending at y=957. Preserve the guide's full occupied bounds x=233..789, y=66..957, asymmetric base spikes (tallest on the right), and narrow edge-on lens-rim projections near y=560..710. Keep the existing central lower pointed recess and all internal buttress boundaries. Do not bend it into the crescent seen in the material reference.
runs.reason: Rejected: native dimensions, silhouette/detail registration and fully flat albedo requirements are not met. One corrective regeneration will be used.

checks.materials_match: Ivory plates, gold-brown veins and blue-white lenses are present.
visual_issues: Model edges and base details drift from the guide.
Lens visibility expanded compared with the edge-on guide.
